description.description: Provide one local workspace for browsing, previewing, editing, searching, and managing Markdown files.
Use a single-process local Flask service as the application and API boundary.
Keep Markdown content local and scope all operations to a selected base directory.
Centralize Markdown conversion, frontmatter extraction, syntax highlighting, Mermaid, math, tables, and table-of-contents support.
Notify browser clients of Markdown changes without polling or full application restarts.
Detect local Markdown changes with debouncing before notifying connected clients.
Resolve user-provided paths and enforce containment under the selected base directory to prevent traversal.
Avoid repeated directory scans while invalidating whenever file state changes.
Reuse rendered HTML with a path, modification-time, and size key so same-mtime writes do not remain stale.
Expose file, search, editor, export, directory, and assistant operations through JSON endpoints.
Retain lightweight filename and path search as the default mode.
Add case-insensitive body-text discovery with contextual snippets while avoiding an index or advanced operators in the first iteration.
Keep one familiar search bar and make content search explicitly opt in.
Show path, line number, nearby context, and highlighted matches with a 50-result cap.
Coordinate backend route, sidebar toggle, result rendering, styling, and verification for full-text search.
Allow optional document-aware assistance through a configurable local or remote chat-completions endpoint.
Provide an in-browser editor with live preview, formatting controls, keybinding modes, and version history.
Produce a portable document with inlined styling.
Offer Terminal, Amber, Dracula, Nord, and Paper appearances with a low-effects option.
Provide the shared sidebar, search controls, modals, theme menu, and frontend script shell.
Render the landing page and recursive Markdown file tree.
Compose reading, outline, editing, exporting, diagram, math, and assistant experiences for one document.
Separate the outline and assistant into tabs so chat history does not bury document navigation.
Use sans or serif prose faces for long-form reading while retaining monospace for headings and code.
Improve secondary-text contrast, touch targets, and high-contrast preference handling.
Expose file status and inline diffs in the Markdown file tree.
Extend sharing beyond the existing standalone HTML export.
Provide keyboard-first access to search, themes, and editor commands.
Turn Markdown sections into a full-screen slideshow.
Enable multiple local-network users to edit together with live cursors.
Provide manual fixtures demonstrating supported Markdown features.
Exercise fenced code rendering across several languages.
Exercise table, list, blockquote, table-of-contents, and mixed-content rendering.
Provide a minimal heading hierarchy for document-outline smoke checks.
Preserve the prior finding that the executable path is connected while project documentation lacked implementation edges.
Preserve the prior portability and semantic-fidelity diagnosis while distinguishing it from application defects.
